sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Anxiety and fear; better lying down. Feels
large and heavy, with rush of blood; pain from above
downward. Field of vision contracted.

sections.label: Mouth
sections.text:
Nodes on palate. Toothache; worse, any-
thing cold. [Coff. opposite.] Hemming all the time.
[Arp. m.; Sil.]

484

sections.label: Nose
sections.text:
Dry, obstructed. Chronic catarrh, with bleed-
ing, dryness ; zvorsc in cold damp ztrathcr.

sections.label: Ears
sections.text:
Feel stopped ; cracking on blowing nose. Pain
from other parts extends to ears. Deafness in damp
weather.

Alimentary Canal. — Tongue sore and irritable with
ulcers or warts. Flatulence ; chronic enlargement of
liver.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Chronic hoarseness. Larynx dry,
rough, constricted. Tuberculosis of larynx. Cough ;
worse evening, and better lying dozmi. Mucus difficult
to loosen. Stitches in larynx extending to ear. Fleat
in chest. Haemoptysis. Every cold rouses up a bron-
chitis. [Dulc.]

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Derangements of menstruation, amenor-
rhoea; menses too early and scanty, in anaemic subjects.
Flushes of heat at climacteric.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Feculiai gait, walks on metacarpo-
phalangeal joint; walks backwards. Ankles painful.
Bones very sensitive. Shiny red swelling of joints.
Knees pain and itch. Rheumatism of feet. Intolerable
pain in skin of lower limbs. Burning spots about joints.
Periosteal inflammation. Suppuration of skin around
joints.

sections.label: Sleep
sections.text: Vivid dreams. Sleepy very early in evening.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Suppuration of skin around joints. Red, ele-
vated spots. Itching; better, scratching. Deep cracks
in bends of elbows, etc. Psoriasis and pityriasis. Burn-
ing around ulcers. Chronic eczema associated with
amenorrhoea, worse at menstrual period or at meno-
pause.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
Worse, cold wet weather, change of
weather. Better, lying down (cough).

MANGANUM ACET. — MANGIFERA IND. — MEUOR. 485

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: Colloidal Manganese (Boils
and other staphylococcal infections) ; Mangan, mur,
(painful ankles, bone-pains) ; Mangan. oxydat. (pain in
tibia, dysmenorrhcea, colic, and diarrhoea). Workers in
Mangan. binoxide are frequently affected with bulbar
paralysis. Use 3x homceopathically. Mangan. sulph,
(liver affections, excess of bile) ; Argent.; Rhus.; Sulph.

Antidotes: Coff.; Merc.
